## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future. He aspires to enter the political sphere and eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane joined the Queen's class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Along with fellow classmates such as [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Charlie prepared to study for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie Sloane and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a relationship marked by mutual distaste and resentment since the start of their acquaintance. Though they both eventually participate in Miss Stacy's advanced Queen's class, their underlying friction persists amid the broader academic rivalries of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), +6 more_
